cluster.description:
C3 Cluster ID component (first) in App ID
E.g. prod-c3-crm
=> prod

env.description:
C3 Environment name (second) component in App ID; e.g. srv,ui,c3.
E.g. prod-c3-crm
=> c3
An Environment name must be unique within a Cluster.

app.description:
C3 Application name (third) component in App ID; e.g. c3,crm,lightbulb
E.g. prod-c3-crm
=> crm
An Application name must be unique within an Environment.
